questions.question: add(x,3) leaves x unchanged. Why?
questions.explanation: C copies args onto the stack; callee writes copies.

questions.question: fill(buf,4) modifies caller's buf. Why?
options: Array decays to pointer; writes go through
questions.explanation: buf passes as &buf[0]; arr[i] dereferences caller memory.

questions.question: Why must array length travel separately?
options: C arrays carry no length; callee can't know
questions.explanation: No bounds metadata — pass n explicitly.

questions.question: strlen("osfs") is 4, not 5. Why?
options: Counts chars before NUL, excluding terminator

questions.question: strcpy needs dst big enough because?
options: It copies until+including NUL with no bounds check
questions.explanation: Overflow corrupts stack; size the buffer or bound the copy.

questions.question: ASan build of an overflow does what?
options: Aborts with precise report (keeps bug loud)
questions.explanation: Instrumentation turns silent corruption into a loud, located failure.
